objective: Test whether true point-in-time announcement-title text representations add stable net marginal alpha beyond the same-data V13 baseline.
immutability: V14 data, code, lock and results remain unchanged.

data.required_quality: announcements is the only accepted V14 external source
data.effective_time: next available trading day after publication calendar date
data.event_document: deduplicated titles joined by symbol and effective trading day
data.event_year_availability: count distinct years from raw effective event documents with event_count greater than zero; never infer from ranked features

text_representation.reason: fixed stateless vocabulary prevents future-corpus vocabulary leakage

targets.definition: next-open to horizon-exit-open return minus point-in-time official-weight broad-sector return minus the pre-existing liquidity-aware round-trip cost
targets.label_maturity: 20-day label end must be before the cutoff minus a 28-calendar-day embargo

model.text_regressor: three chronological averaged elastic-net Huber SGD regressors with a fixed 30 epochs and no tolerance-based early stop
model.final_score: 75 percent same-data V13 comparable score plus 25 percent recent title-text score

validation.minimum_raw_event_years: all raw event years available at that fold capped at 4, at least 1

decision_policy: Freeze data, text corpus, code, dependencies and environment before the first V15 performance run. Failed retrospective gates keep V6 in production.
